title: Internship Completion and Career Readiness
description: Capstone course combining active internship hours with career launch preparation. Students work directly with real clients, demonstrate all CHW roles in practice, refine resumes, cover letters, and bios, and develop professional workplace skills.
notes: Adapted from Calbright College CHW program outline (course 06 / CHW 506), renumbered per CCC convention.
lesson_length: Lab-guide lessons, roughly 1500-2000 words each, supporting instructor-led sessions and independent study
learning_objectives: Demonstrate CHW roles in practice with real clients under supervision
Refine a resume, cover letter, and professional bio for CHW roles
Demonstrate professional workplace skills: reliability, documentation, boundaries, and teamwork

lessons.title: Demonstrating CHW Roles in Practice
objectives: Demonstrate CHW roles in practice with real clients under supervision
Map internship activities to the C3 roles they evidence

lessons.title: Working with Real Clients Under Supervision
objectives: Work with real clients while maintaining confidentiality, boundaries, and supervision practices
Bring boundary and safety concerns to a field mentor early

lessons.title: Resume, Cover Letter, and Professional Bio
objectives: Refine a resume, cover letter, and professional bio for CHW roles
Translate internship experience into quantified, verifiable statements

lessons.title: Professional Workplace Skills
objectives: Demonstrate professional workplace skills: reliability, documentation, boundaries, and teamwork
Complete workplace documentation accurately and within required timeframes

sequencing_rationale: Course 6 of 6: the capstone — active internship hours plus career launch. Role demonstration first (what the internship must evidence), the supervised client-work project second as the heart of the course, then career materials and workplace professionalism to close the program. Scope assumption: this course assesses transfer — competencies already taught in CHW102-104 now demonstrated with real clients under supervision — so lessons re-tag a representative cross-domain sample rather than re-teaching; resume/cover-letter content is raised as a proposed competency.

proposed_competencies.competency_text: The learner can produce a resume, cover letter, and professional bio that present CHW experience in employer-ready form.
proposed_competencies.rationale: CHW106 lesson 4 is career-materials content; the skills matrix has no career-readiness competency.
